additionalDocuments.label: SAMANA Barari Views · original official brochure and home drawings

review.imagery: Seventeen own-project renders cover the tower, podium, private/shared pools, golf practice space, lobby, gym and home interiors. All 25 native brochure resources and six primary gallery images were visually reviewed against the whole brochure index. Generic foliage/forest/people/technology photographs and the unpainted aerial resource are excluded. The tower shown on physical page 5 is an own-project illustration. The current full-tower sunset image supplies the card and hero. The spa image is a treatment room. Proposed views remain unit-unspecific.
review.floorPlans: Four complete official home sheets show studio, 1 BR, 2 BR and 3 BR pool layouts. Six complete building sheets from the branded broker mirror cover the source’s exact floor groups through floor 28. The rooftop/28th-floor legend lists 2 BR and 3 BR. Floor 11 retains its mechanical-room footprint. Numerical unit areas and approved numbered-unit matching are not stated on these sheets. Confirm the contractual configuration, area and pool provision with SAMANA. All four complete official home sheets 29–32 and all six mirror physical pages 2–7 were visually reviewed. The exact enumerated floor groups were transcribed without collapsing them into an incorrect continuous range. They collectively cover floors 1–28. Original legends, mechanical-room footprint and rooftop categories remain intact. No numerical home area is inferred from room sizes, source building totals or generic category minima.
review.location: The complete official physical page 9 map and all thirteen printed travel entries were visually reviewed. Current-primary travel conflicts are explicit. Majan is retained as the primary FAQ’s project community, with wider Al Barari context clearly scoped. The name-only official map query is stored with HTML hash. No coordinate, exact plot frontage or visitor entrance is inferred.
review.provenance: Primary HTML, official brochure bytes, native image origins and Mitchell’s complete branded floorplate PDF retain source receipts and hashes. The floorplate source remains labeled as a broker mirror. Original pages preserve content, branding and physical PDF-page links. Protected identity and completed text research remain intact.

unavailable: Drawing-specific numerical home areas, approved contractual unit matching, resolution of conflicting journey estimates, exact visitor entrance coordinates, final unit fitout/views and dated construction photographs were not established.
